街灯把路面染成金色

空荡的 avenue 我们走过

每扇窗 每个霓虹的记号

在霓虹之城 的光芒里飞驰

nodes.title: Lyrics

widgets_values: Pop, Dream Pop, Melancholic, Low, Female Solo, An intimate acoustic ballad featuring soft fingerpicked guitar, gentle ambient pads, and a haunting female lead voice conveying quiet longing over warm, diffused lighting — evoking nostalgia through delicate textures and restrained emotion.

Verse 1
Two braids down my shoulders,
silence where laughter used to be.
Coffee's cold now on the table,
your name still echoes in my ear.

Pre-Chorus
I traced your face in yesterday’s light,
turned it into something I can’t hold.

Chorus
We were never meant to stay here,
in these chairs we didn't choose.
The world spins slow but you're gone—
can’t find you even in the shadows.

Verse 2
This cup holds memories half-forgotten,
dandelion seeds drifting away.
Every step feels heavier since you left—
a ghost in every streetlight glow.

Bridge
Maybe love doesn't need a reason,
just silence and the weight of time.
And if you’re out there somewhere…
do you hear me whisper ‘you’?

Final Chorus
We were never meant to stay here,
in these chairs we didn't choose.
The world spins slow but you're gone—
can’t find you even in the shadows.

Outro
(soft fade)
...and the coffee cools...
...the daisy fades...
...but I’m still holding onto nothing...
